$comment: Repo-level MCP server configuration. Read by Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP-aware clients. VS Code Copilot does NOT read this file for codegraph — see .vscode/mcp.json's own comment. scaffold.sh appends a --path argument to this file's codegraph args when scaffolding a new project.

codegraph.$comment: CodeGraph — semantic code intelligence: symbol lookup, callers/callees, route mapping. This copy ships path-less; scaffold.sh writes a project-specific copy with --path baked in to the absolute project path, so every MCP client works correctly. VS Code Copilot deliberately does not get a codegraph entry (see .vscode/mcp.json) to avoid a duplicate, inactive registration. See docs/guides/MCP_SETUP.md.
